detailed_descriptions_html.en:
One billion dollars. One shredder. You.

A gigantic bank vault is buried under money up to the ceiling — mountains of bills and bundles. Your job is simple and glorious: dig through all that wealth and feed it to the shredder. Every bill pays out, every upgrade makes you faster, and the mountain keeps shrinking.

Grab, scoop, suck it up

Start with your bare hands: grab bills one by one and carry them to the shredder. Then go bigger: a bucket, a shovel and a powerful vacuum that pulls money in a swirling vortex. When your hands get tired, launch drones — they mine and haul the cash without you.

Upgrades you can't put down

  • Over 100 upgrades for your tools, the shredder and your drones

  • A skill tree with branches for your play style

  • Boosts, relics and golden banknotes for the long run

  • Numbers climb from your first dollars to trillions — and beyond

A secret at the bottom of the vault

The vault goes five levels deep. The deeper you dig, the bigger the bills. Shred every last bill, pick up the golden key and open the massive door at the bottom. What's behind it? Find out for yourself.

Better together

Play solo or invite up to three friends to online co-op. Shared progress, one shared mountain of money, voice and text chat — dig together, argue about who buys the next upgrade, and shred a billion as a team.

Features

  • A cozy first-person incremental game

  • Exactly one billion banknotes in the vault, counted down to the very last one

  • Online co-op for up to 4 players with voice chat

  • Drone automation — up to 16 drones dig and haul the cash on their own

  • Five signature moves: ARMFUL, HEAVE, GROUND POUND, OVERLOAD and RALLY

  • The jetpack lifts you out of any pit

  • Customize your thief and find hats in buried chests

  • A Steam leaderboard for the fastest vault clear, solo and in co-op

  • 100 Steam achievements

  • Fully localized into 30 languages
